lines.speaker: baker
lines.text: What a beautiful morning in the Coral Reef! Founder's Day is TODAY.

lines.speaker: coral
lines.text: Baker! Over here! Something terrible has happened!

lines.speaker: baker
lines.text: Hmm. That doesn't go there. Let me try something else.

lines.speaker: coral
lines.text: The Festival Gate stays shut until the Great Conch Shell comes home. That's the rule!

lines.speaker: baker
lines.text: Then I'd better find it. No shell, no festival!

lines.speaker: coral
lines.text: Baker, the Great Conch Shell is GONE! The festival can't start without it!

lines.speaker: baker
lines.text: Gone? Don't worry, Coral. We'll find it. I'm sure it hasn't gone fin-ishingly far.

lines.speaker: coral
lines.text: Oh, I hope so. Grandma Grouper was out early this morning. Maybe she saw something!

lines.speaker: coral
lines.text: Grandma Grouper is on her rock, over to the left. She sees EVERYTHING. Well, most things.

lines.speaker: coral
lines.text: Any luck? I've been worrying so hard my tail curled up twice.

lines.speaker: coral
lines.text: Grandma said the shadow went toward the Kelp Forest. The arrow on the right takes you there.

lines.speaker: coral
lines.text: A WHALE has the shell? On his TAIL? Oh my. Oh my, oh my.

lines.speaker: coral
lines.text: Is there anything that could pop it loose? Or pry it? Think, Baker, think!

lines.speaker: coral
lines.text: You FOUND it! Baker, you're o-fish-ally my hero!

lines.speaker: coral
lines.text: Quick, take it through the Festival Gate! DJ Dolphin is waiting on the stage.

lines.speaker: coral
lines.text: Best. Founder's Day. EVER. Do you think the balloons are tied tight enough, though?

lines.speaker: coral
lines.text: A kelp cookie! Oh, thank you. I'll eat it slowly so I don't get nervous crumbs.

lines.speaker: grandma
lines.text: Good morning, dear! Happy Founder's Day. Coral looks like she wants to tell you something.

lines.speaker: grandma
lines.text: The Conch Shell is missing? Oh dear. Oh deary dear. Let me think...

lines.speaker: grandma
lines.text: This morning I saw a big gray shadow swoosh past, heading for the Kelp Forest. It was chasing krill, I think.

lines.speaker: baker
lines.text: A big gray shadow! That's a clue. Thanks, Grandma!

lines.speaker: grandma
lines.text: Oh, and dear, if you spot my kelp-cookie recipe page out there, bring it back. The current took it right out of my fins.

lines.speaker: grandma
lines.text: The gray shadow went toward the Kelp Forest, dear. Mr. Puffer lives out that way.

lines.speaker: grandma
lines.text: He makes those lovely bubbles. Very useful, bubbles. You can breathe in a big one, you know!

lines.speaker: grandma
lines.text: Dear, I'll say it plain: go RIGHT, to the Kelp Forest. Find the gear in the kelp and give it to Mr. Puffer's machine.

lines.speaker: grandma
lines.text: Then he'll give you a Bubble Helmet, and you can go into the Dark Cave. That's where shadows go!

lines.speaker: grandma
lines.text: You can breathe and see in the dark now! The Dark Cave is past the Kelp Forest.

lines.speaker: grandma
lines.text: Big gray shadows love dark caves. Don't be shy, dear. Shy never found a shell.

lines.speaker: grandma
lines.text: Kelp Forest, then the arrow on the right into the Dark Cave. Then click the big gray thing. Go on, dear!

lines.speaker: grandma
lines.text: Stuck on a whale's tail! Well, I never. A big bubble could pop it right off.

lines.speaker: grandma
lines.text: Or Captain Clam's ship is full of old tools. A crowbar would do it, gently.

lines.speaker: grandma
lines.text: You've got it! Up through the Festival Gate, dear. Tell DJ Dolphin I said turn it down a smidge.

lines.speaker: grandma
lines.text: Is that my recipe page in your fin? Click it in your inventory, then click me, dear. My fins are full of knitting.

lines.speaker: grandma
lines.text: The Great Conch Shell! It's even bigger than I remember. Off to the festival with you!

lines.speaker: grandma
lines.text: My recipe! Oh, you wonderful fish. Now, the secret ingredient is love, and a little bit of seaweed.

lines.speaker: grandma
lines.text: Here, take a kelp cookie. Take a WHOLE batch. They never run out; that's the love part.

lines.speaker: grandma
lines.text: Offering me my own cookie? You're a sweet one. No thank you, dear, I've had eleven.

lines.speaker: grandma
lines.text: What a day! I'm so proud I could burst. Don't tell Mr. Puffer I said 'burst'.

lines.speaker: sidney
lines.text: Psst, Baker, can I tell you a secret? I want to dance at the festival, but I'm too shy.

lines.speaker: baker
lines.text: Sidney, you'd be great! Crabs are natural dancers. You've got eight left feet!

lines.speaker: sidney
lines.text: ...Was that a compliment? Okay. Will you practice with me? Watch my moves, then copy them!

lines.speaker: sidney
lines.text: Ready to practice my dance again? I promise not to knock over the sandcastle this time.

lines.speaker: sidney
lines.text: We did it! I feel so brave I could dance sideways across the whole reef!

lines.speaker: sidney
lines.text: Here, take my spare dance shoes. I only need eight. Wear them at the festival!

lines.speaker: sidney
lines.text: Sideways, sideways, spin! I've been practicing. I only knocked over the sandcastle twice.

lines.speaker: sidney
lines.text: A cookie! I'll hold it with my left claw. No, my other left claw. No, my OTHER other left claw.

lines.speaker: sidney
lines.text: Those are for YOU, Baker. Try them on the dance floor at the festival!

lines.speaker: puffer
lines.text: Hmph. Don't mind me. Just a puffer fish with a busted bubble machine on the biggest day of the year.

lines.speaker: baker
lines.text: What's wrong with it, Mr. Puffer?

lines.speaker: puffer
lines.text: Lost a gear. And I'm too puffed up to squeeze into the kelp to look for it. It's a sore subject, so don't needle me.

lines.speaker: puffer
lines.text: Still no gear. It's small and brass and it's somewhere down in that kelp. I'm not pointing; I'm sulking.

lines.speaker: puffer
lines.text: You FOUND it! Well don't give it to me, I've got no thumbs. Pop it in the machine over there.

lines.speaker: puffer
lines.text: Not on ME, kid, on the MACHINE! The big clanky thing right next to me.

lines.speaker: baker
lines.text: A bubble machine! There's an empty slot where a gear should go. It's making a sad 'pfft' noise.

lines.speaker: baker
lines.text: Click! The gear fits perfectly. The machine is starting to rumble...

lines.speaker: puffer
lines.text: It's working! Quick, the bubbles come out a bit wild at first. Catch a few so they don't float off!

lines.speaker: puffer
lines.text: Ha! Look at that. Bubbles shaped like boots, sandwiches, Grandma's face... I'll fix THAT setting later.

lines.speaker: puffer
lines.text: Here. One extra-large bubble helmet. You can breathe in it anywhere, even the Dark Cave. Don't pop it on a rock.

lines.speaker: baker
lines.text: The machine is humming happily. A bubble shaped like a teapot floats by.

lines.speaker: puffer
lines.text: Machine's purring. I'm almost not grumpy. Almost. Go find that shell, kid.

lines.speaker: puffer
lines.text: A cookie? For me? ...Hmph. Thanks. If I eat it I'll puff up even more, but it's worth it.

lines.speaker: shelly
lines.text: Oh! Hello, sandwich. Have you seen my glasses? I can't find anything without them.

lines.speaker: baker
lines.text: I'm Baker, Shelly. A fish, not a sandwich. What do your glasses look like?

lines.speaker: shelly
lines.text: Pink and round. I lost them near the old ship. I think. Something shiny went tumbling that way too, a big something.

lines.speaker: shelly
lines.text: Hello again, sandwich. I mean Baker. If you're near the Sunken Ship, keep an eye out for my glasses.

lines.speaker: shelly
lines.text: Is that... a pink blur in your fin? Click it in your inventory and then click me, please!

lines.speaker: shelly
lines.text: My glasses! Oh... you're a FISH, and a very nice-looking one. I'm so embarrassed!

lines.speaker: shelly
lines.text: Now I remember properly: the shiny thing was a huge shell, stuck on a whale's tail. He headed into the Dark Cave past here.

lines.speaker: shelly
lines.text: Take my shell polish as a thank you. Whatever you find, it'll be shell-shockingly shiny.

lines.speaker: shelly
lines.text: I can see everything now! That rock is a snail. That snail is a rock. Life is full of surprises.

lines.speaker: shelly
lines.text: A cookie! Finally, something I was RIGHT about being food. Thank you, Baker.

lines.speaker: baker
lines.text: Whoa, it's pitch dark in there, and the water smells funny. I can't go in like this.

lines.speaker: baker
lines.text: I'd need a light, or a big bubble of fresh air to breathe. Mr. Puffer makes bubbles...

lines.speaker: clam
lines.text: AHOY! Captain Clam, retired, at your service. Did I ever tell you about the time I wrestled a kraken?

lines.speaker: baker
lines.text: Hi Captain! I'm looking for the Great Conch Shell. Have you seen anything shiny fall this way?

lines.speaker: clam
lines.text: Shiny? My lucky pearl rolled into that chest and the lid snapped shut! A tragedy of the seven seas!

lines.speaker: clam
lines.text: Get it back and I'll give you the key to my treasure room. OR make me laugh, and I'll give you the key anyway. I'm easy.

lines.speaker: clam
lines.text: Back again, young fish! What'll it be?

lines.speaker: clam
lines.text: A joke contest! Let's hear your best one. I warn you, I haven't laughed since 1998.

lines.speaker: baker
lines.text: Okay, Captain...

choices.text: Why don't fish do well in school? They're always below sea level!
What do you call a clam that won't share? Shellfish!
How does a dolphin make a decision? He flipper coin!

lines.speaker: clam
lines.text: HAR HAR HAR! Below sea level! Oh, my hinges! That's the finest joke on the seven seas!

lines.speaker: clam
lines.text: A deal's a deal. Here's the key to the treasure room. Mind the spoons.

lines.speaker: clam
lines.text: SHELLFISH! HAR HAR! You dare joke about clams to a clam? I LOVE it!

lines.speaker: clam
lines.text: A deal's a deal. Here's the key to the treasure room. Mind the spoons.

lines.speaker: clam
lines.text: FLIPPER COIN! Oh ho ho, I'm going to tell DJ Dolphin that one myself!

lines.speaker: clam
lines.text: A deal's a deal. Here's the key to the treasure room. Mind the spoons.

lines.speaker: clam
lines.text: The chest has three shells on the lid. Match them to the pattern and it pops open like a surprised oyster.

lines.speaker: clam
lines.text: Click the chest to have a go. If you get stuck, the shells sort of... help. Old chest, kind heart.

lines.speaker: clam
lines.text: Picture it: the storm of '82. Waves as tall as whales. And ME, alone, wrestling a kraken with one hinge tied behind my back!

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: (Pip shakes his head slowly.)

lines.speaker: clam
lines.text: Don't listen to Pip, he wasn't there, mostly. Anyway, where was I? Right, the kraken!

lines.speaker: clam
lines.text: Is that my PEARL? Click it in your inventory, then click me! My hinges are trembling!

lines.speaker: clam
lines.text: MY PEARL! Oh, you brave, clever fish. This is better than the time I wrestled TWO krakens!

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: (Pip shakes his head.)

lines.speaker: clam
lines.text: The treasure room is yours to explore. If I haven't given you the key already, take it now!

lines.speaker: clam
lines.text: The treasure room is at the back, young fish. Lanterns, crowbars, spoons. SO many spoons.

lines.speaker: clam
lines.text: Did I tell you about the time a brave fish rescued my pearl? Fought off a sea monster to do it!

lines.speaker: baker
lines.text: Captain, that was me. It was a puzzle box.

lines.speaker: clam
lines.text: A puzzle box MONSTER. Pip, write that down.

lines.speaker: clam
lines.text: A kelp cookie! Reminds me of the time I wrestled a kraken over the last biscuit. Pip, stop shaking your head.

lines.speaker: baker
lines.text: A heavy wooden door with a big iron lock. Captain Clam has the key.

lines.speaker: baker
lines.text: Creeeak! The door swings open. There's a lantern, a crowbar, a LOT of spoons... and something pink and round.

lines.speaker: baker
lines.text: It's so dark. But I can see glowing spots... and something very, very big breathing.

lines.speaker: bill
lines.text: Oh no, hello, little fish, please don't be scared! I'm Bill, Barnacle Bill, and I'm sorry about... everything.

lines.speaker: baker
lines.text: I'm Baker! Bill, that's the Great Conch Shell on your tail!

lines.speaker: bill
lines.text: I KNOW. I was chasing krill, I did a big turn, and SCHLOOP. It's wedged tight. I've been hiding in here, so embarrassed.

lines.speaker: baker
lines.text: Nobody's mad, Bill. Let's get it off and bring it to the festival together!

lines.speaker: bill
lines.text: It's really stuck. Maybe a big bubble could pop it loose, or something strong to pry with? I'd do it, but... no fingers.

lines.speaker: bill
lines.text: You've got something that might work! Click it in your inventory, then click the shell on my tail. I'll hold very, very still.

lines.speaker: bill
lines.text: Ha, that tickles! But the shell's on my TAIL, friend. Down at the other end. I'm a lot of whale.

lines.speaker: baker
lines.text: That's the Conch Shell! But it's attached to something enormous. I should say hello first.

lines.speaker: baker
lines.text: It's wedged on tight. I need something to pop it loose, or pry it off gently.

lines.speaker: baker
lines.text: I'll slide the Bubble Helmet under the edge and... POP!

lines.speaker: bill
lines.text: WHOA! It's off! Oh, that feels SO much better. You're a wonder, Baker!

lines.speaker: baker
lines.text: Easy does it... a little wiggle with the crowbar and... CLUNK!

lines.speaker: bill
lines.text: It's off! Oh, that feels SO much better. You're a wonder, Baker!

lines.speaker: bill
lines.text: Take the shell to the festival, Baker. I'll follow... slowly. I'm trying not to bump anything.

lines.speaker: bill
lines.text: I made it to the festival and only knocked over two balloons! Thank you for being my friend, Baker.

lines.speaker: bill
lines.text: A cookie for me? It's so tiny and so kind. I'll save it for a whale of a special occasion.

lines.speaker: dj
lines.text: DJ Dolphin here, live from the main stage! We are ON HOLD until the Great Conch Shell arrives, fishes!

lines.speaker: dj
lines.text: Is that... IS THAT THE GREAT CONCH SHELL? Baker, you absolute LEGEND of the lagoon!

lines.speaker: baker
lines.text: Barnacle Bill had it stuck on his tail. It was an accident. He's really sorry.

lines.speaker: dj
lines.text: Accidents happen, we forgive and we GROOVE. Help me kick off the festival. Click the glowing notes with me!

lines.speaker: dj
lines.text: The shell is home, the beat is bumpin', and you, Baker, are the star of the sea! Keep dancing, everybody!

lines.speaker: dj
lines.text: A kelp cookie for the DJ? Now THAT'S what I call a request! Crunch-tastic!

lines.speaker: dj
lines.text: Sparkly dance shoes! Hit the dance floor to the right and show us the Sidney Shuffle!

lines.speaker: baker
lines.text: A little polish, a little rub... WOW. I can see my whole face in it.

lines.speaker: baker
lines.text: Uh oh. I can see a LOT of my face in it. Is my fin always that goofy?
